name: Maximilien
source:
Although he is the manager of the theater, he tends to be absent due to his wanderlust, and it is a mystery whether he fulfills his role as manager.
He is usually aloof, but he sometimes shows a chilling and cold side.
He is kind to women, and seems to be particularly fond of the heroine.

[Translated from the [url=https://twitter.com/CFGame_veribaro/status/1553319499834593280]official twtter[/url]]
